messages:
Harper: dropped a quick sketch for a 'peek' affordance when a single point would force a chart to rescale. idea: keep main view at trend scale and show a small inline peek card anchored to the point with a callout line. figma: https://figma.redwood/peek-affordance
Noel: I like keeping trend context. Q: should peek be purely visual or also affect hover/tooltips? I think tooltip should always show true value, peek is just a visual expansion but optional to "open full".
Dina: visual-only by default. add an explicit CTA on peek: 'Expand full range' which toggles chart scaling. CTA must be keyboard-focusable.
Ethan: implementation: backend can return an array of peek_points: [{series_id, ts, raw_value, reason}] so front-end draws peek card without fetching raw series. also add summary stats per-series (p50/p95/p999) to help decide peek thresholds.
Harper: copy nit: use 'Peek outlier' as label? or 'Outlier peek'? Which reads better in the UI?
Noel: 'Outlier peek' feels clearer. also show small badge in legend row when that series has a visible peek. badge text short like 'peek'.
Dina: accessibility: peek card must be reachable by keyboard, have aria-describedby with readable text 'Outlier at 12,345 on 2026-03-05, press enter to expand chart'. Prefer aria-live polite when a peek appears on live dashboards.
A11yBot: checklist: ensure peek control is focusable, provide aria-label and aria-describedby, visible focus ring, and a skip-link to jump to expanded chart view. If peek auto-appears, use aria-live polite + a manual focus target to avoid surprise.
Ethan: narrow screens: transform peek into a stacked mini-card under the chart (no overlay) to avoid covering controls. legend behavior: collapsed legend should surface pinned series names; others show swatches + truncated name with focusable chevron to expand details.
Harper: smoothing rule: default OFF for <2k points, else default to Low (0.25). show a tiny sample sparkline next to smoothing presets so people can preview.
Noel: perf: front-end should use canvas for main lines and layered HTML for interactive peeks/tooltips. payload shape: downsampled + peek_points + series_summary is minimal and easy to render.
Dina: action items: Harper update figma with peek card copy + focus styles; Ethan draft API sketch for peek_points + summaries; Noel to add legend-badge + collapsed legend chevron mock; A11yBot will run the checklist after prototypes. target: internal review Friday. :calendar:
Harper: thanks team, I'll post updated frames and numbered comments.
